latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Construction Meeting Minutes Generator skill.

- Converts rough notes or voice transcriptions into structured, professional construction meeting minutes.
- Automatically extracts and separates action items, decisions, and flags items with contractual/commercial implications.
- Prompts for any missing essential meeting information (such as title, date, attendees).
- Provides a standardized format with sections for agenda, actions, decisions log, and contractual flags.
- Ensures all actions have a responsible person and deadline, and decisions are clearly attributed.
